correctness.rationale: The seven support masks and their part multiplicities saturated at two constitute an exact finite factor, since successor availability depends only on whether each color occurs in zero, one, or at least two parts. The 2158 realizable signatures have been enumerated; each reaches the globally all-advancing or monochromatic class within two updates, with exact three-step return thereafter. Lifting to labelled vertices gives F^5=F^2 for every r≥3 and all positive sizes. Every all-advancing configuration rotates globally, every monochromatic state fixes, and all other states are transient. Inclusion-exclusion over exact part supports proves the recurrence sum. Exact direct graph tests total 24246 states and verify sharp transient witnesses; those finite tests are corroboration, not an extrapolated proof.

value.rationale: A complete sharp all-size dynamical classification on a natural dense multipartite graph family, revealing that the addition of a third part suppresses bipartite period-four attractors. Its exact fixed/period-three orbit counts and zeta function permit asymptotic or probabilistic analysis on arbitrary multipartition shapes. The two-step bound is sharp and stronger than the related Greenberg–Hastings four-step bound, distinguishing two classic excitable rules. The 2158-state exact quotient supplies a structural finite proof rather than an arbitrary small-case census.
